annotations.title: Zoning scheme for a South African place

description: The land use / zoning scheme (zoning scheme regulations) and the municipal planning by-law that apply in a South African place, with dates, gazette references, official links and doc_ids. These set what each zone allows (coverage, height, building lines, parking, consent uses) and how to apply for rezoning or departures. It does NOT say how a particular erf is zoned — that is on the municipality's zoning map or zoning certificate.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")
